headline.title: How Apple’s big lawsuit could disrupt OpenAI’s IPO plans
headline.summary: Apple has filed a trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging misconduct involving the company's chief hardware officer and claiming that over 400 former Apple employees are now with OpenAI. This legal challenge could potentially disrupt OpenAI's plans for an initial public offering (IPO).

articles.title: Patreon stops asking AI bots not to scrape — and starts blocking them
articles.summary: Patreon is collaborating with Cloudflare to implement measures that block AI bots from scraping creators' content without permission. This change signifies a transition from merely requesting compliance through robots.txt to actively preventing unauthorized AI training.

articles.title: Why the first GPU financiers are turning to inference chips in a $400 million deal
articles.summary: A $400 million loan backed by chips signals a shift among GPU financiers towards investing in inference chips, highlighting a growing trend in AI infrastructure financing. This move reflects the increasing demand for advanced AI capabilities and the evolving landscape of chip technology.

articles.title: Fine-tune video and image models at scale with NVIDIA NeMo Automodel and 🤗 Diffusers
articles.summary: NVIDIA has introduced NeMo Automodel, a tool designed to facilitate the fine-tuning of video and image models at scale, enhancing the efficiency of model training. This development is complemented by the integration of 🤗 Diffusers, which streamlines the process for users in the AI community.

articles.title: Apple’s lawsuit couldn’t come at a worse time for OpenAI
articles.summary: Apple has filed a trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging misconduct involving OpenAI's chief hardware officer and claiming that over 400 former Apple employees are now at the company. The lawsuit comes at a critical time for OpenAI, as it is reportedly preparing for an initial public offering (IPO).

articles.title: A scorecard for the AI age
articles.summary: Sarah Friar, CFO of OpenAI, has introduced a practical AI scorecard designed to evaluate return on investment (ROI) by assessing factors such as useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute. This tool aims to provide organizations with a structured approach to measure the effectiveness of their AI implementations.

articles.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin Maximizes Intelligence per Dollar for Post-Training Workloads — a Key Metric for Agentic AI
articles.summary: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin architecture optimizes cost efficiency for post-training workloads by achieving the lowest cost per token through extreme codesign. This advancement is positioned as a crucial metric for enhancing agentic AI capabilities.

articles.title: Announcing the Corrigibility Research Fund
articles.summary: The Corrigibility Research Fund, managed by Lightcone Infrastructure, will allocate at least $200,000 in grants and prizes for research on AI corrigibility in 2026, with the first application deadline set for August 23rd. The fund aims to support both traditional grants and recognize outstanding work completed this year in the field.

articles.title: San Francisco Demands Apple and Google Delete AI ‘Nudify’ Apps From App Stores
articles.summary: San Francisco's City Attorney's Office has issued cease-and-desist letters to Apple and Google, demanding the removal of 13 "face-swap" apps that are primarily used to create non-consensual nude images of women and girls. The city argues that these apps contribute to harassment and exploitation, prompting the call for their deletion from app stores.

articles.title: The risk of weather data sabotage is rising
articles.summary: The article discusses the increasing risk of sabotage to weather data, which is critical for decision-making in various industries such as aviation, agriculture, and energy. As reliance on weather forecasts grows, the potential for malicious manipulation poses significant threats to economic stability and safety.

articles.title: A Humanoid Company Backed by Eric Trump Is Preparing Its Robots for War
articles.summary: Foundation Future Industries, a humanoid robotics company with Eric Trump as chief strategy adviser, is developing robots for potential military applications. The CEO revealed that the company is investigating "kinetic things" as part of its technological advancements.

articles.title: HP fined 1.4 billion rupees for “cartelization” of ink cartridges, toner, PCs
articles.summary: HP has been fined 1.4 billion rupees for engaging in "cartelization" related to its ink cartridges, toner, and PCs, following allegations that resellers were pressured to avoid counterfeit products. The ruling highlights concerns over anti-competitive practices in the printing supplies market.
